# Ending Support in 2006 - Microsoft Lifecycle | Microsoft Learn

![](/en-us/lifecycle/media/search.png) Please go [here](/en-us/lifecycle/products/) to search for your product's lifecycle.

The following list represents products retiring or reaching the end of support in 2006. Upon retirement or end of support, there will be no new security updates, non-security updates, free or paid assisted support options or online technical content updates. Go [here](/en-us/lifecycle/overview/product-end-of-support-overview) to learn about Fixed and Modern Lifecycle policies and service packs.

If you have any questions regarding support for a product, please contact your Microsoft Account Representative. If you need technical support, visit the [Microsoft Support](https://support.microsoft.com/contactus/?ws=support) website.

## Products reaching End of Support

The following products and releases, governed by the [Fixed Policy](/en-us/lifecycle/policies/fixed), will end support in 2006.

| Product | End of Support |
| --- | --- |
| [Microsoft Identity Integration Server 2003](/en-us/lifecycle/products/microsoft-identity-integration-server-2003?branch=live)[Microsoft Office SharePoint Portal Server 2003](/en-us/lifecycle/products/microsoft-office-sharepoint-portal-server-2003?branch=live) | January 10, 2006 |
| [Microsoft Internet Security and Acceleration Server 2004](/en-us/lifecycle/products/microsoft-internet-security-and-acceleration-server-2004?branch=live) | March 11, 2006 |
| [Microsoft BizTalk Server 2004](/en-us/lifecycle/products/microsoft-biztalk-server-2004?branch=live) | April 11, 2006 |
| [Microsoft Content Management Server 2002, Service Pack 1](/en-us/lifecycle/products/microsoft-content-management-server-2002?branch=live) | July 11, 2006 |
| [Microsoft Office 2003, Service Pack 1](/en-us/lifecycle/products/microsoft-office-2003?branch=live)[Microsoft Office OneNote 2003, Service Pack 1](/en-us/lifecycle/products/microsoft-office-onenote-2003?branch=live)[Microsoft Office Project 2003, Service Pack 1](/en-us/lifecycle/products/microsoft-office-project-2003?branch=live)[Microsoft Office Project Server 2003, Service Pack 1](/en-us/lifecycle/products/microsoft-office-project-server-2003?branch=live)[Microsoft Operations Manager (MOM) 2005](/en-us/lifecycle/products/microsoft-operations-manager-mom-2005?branch=live)[Microsoft Windows XP Media Center Edition 2004](/en-us/lifecycle/products/microsoft-windows-xp-media-center-edition-2004?branch=live)[Visio 2003, Service Pack 1](/en-us/lifecycle/products/visio-2003?branch=live)[Windows XP, Service Pack 1](/en-us/lifecycle/products/windows-xp?branch=live)[Windows XP, Service Pack 1a](/en-us/lifecycle/products/windows-xp?branch=live)[Windows XP Tablet PC Edition](/en-us/lifecycle/products/windows-xp-tablet-pc-edition?branch=live) | October 10, 2006 |

## Products moving to Extended Support

The following products will be moving from Mainstream to Extended Support in 2006. Extended Support includes security updates at no cost, and paid non-security updates and support. Additionally, Microsoft will not accept requests for design changes or new features during the Extended Support phase.

| Product | End of Mainstream Support |
| --- | --- |
| [Office XP](/en-us/lifecycle/products/office-xp?branch=live)[SharePoint Team Services 1.0](/en-us/lifecycle/products/sharepoint-team-services-10?branch=live) | July 11, 2006 |
